 All GTA 6 Cheats—Best Grand Theft Auto 6 Cheat Codes
 Grand Theft Auto games have always been the perfect place to let loose and cause a little chaos, with their expansive open worlds giving you plenty of freedom to do whatever you want. GTA 6 is no different, and while there’s plenty of fun to be had completing missions and planning heists, sometimes you just want to cause some mayhem, spawn vehicles, or get your hands on some easy cash. That’s where cheat codes come in.
 Cheats have been a staple of the Grand Theft Auto franchise for decades, and you probably remember scribbling down your favourite combinations on a piece of paper to keep them close at hand. Thankfully, GTA 6 makes things a little easier, with a range of cheats available to shake up your experience and offer some unique ways to explore Vice City.
 Whether you’re looking to spawn vehicles, unlock special abilities, or simply wreak havoc across the map, here’s a complete breakdown of every GTA 6 cheat code and what each one does.
 You can buy Grand Theft Auto 6 here if you haven’t already!
 How Many Cheat Codes Are There In GTA 6?
 Enough. Credit to Rockstar Games 
 There are 61 cheats to use in Grand Theft Auto 6, ranging from combat and player cheats to vehicle spawns and environmental changes. 
 It’s important to note that these cheats can only be used after completing the main story, with most requiring you to meet certain unlock requirements. 
 Related: Complete GTA 6 Trophy List—How To Get All Trophies & Achievements 
 What’s more pressing, though, is that inputting any cheat code will disable trophies and achievements from unlocking , as well as saving the game—but only for the remainder of that play session. Only use these if you’re looking to kick back and mess around, as they won’t help you progress in any way.
 How To Use Cheats In GTA 6
 Don’t tell. Credit to Rockstar Games 
 To input cheat codes in GTA 6, you’ll need to use the in-game phone by pressing up on the D-Pad, then hold L1/LB and press R1/RB followed by the cheat input. 
 You’ll know that cheats are unlocked and usable, as a new Cheats List menu will appear under the Progress Menu. This won’t appear during the story, once again showing that you’ll need to beat the main game first.
 Related: All GTA 6 Guides, Walkthroughs, Best Tips & Tricks 
 Of course, each cheat has its own input you’ll need to use, and they range from giving instant money to making you drunk—a true variety. You’ll find the full list of cheat codes below.
 All GTA 6 Cheat Codes
 Let the fun begin. Credit to Rockstar Games 
 Here’s every cheat code in Grand Theft Auto 6, including how to unlock them and what they do. 
 Note that this list is a work in progress , with some inputs still being discovered, and a shout-out to Powerpyx for the current rundown. As we at Insider Gaming continue to make progress through the game, we’ll be sure to update the following tables accordingly.
 All codes require input from the D-Pad, and you’ll find the directional inputs needed below:
